name: Okusuri Nonde mo Naoranai
original_name: おくすりのんでもなおらない
source:
The main character, Kanata, goes to a psychotherapist once a month.
One day at the hospital, he happens to meet a classmate, Wataru, and they become friends.

However, Wataru is...

"All mentally ill people cut themselves, don't they?"
"You're not really depressed if you don't cut yourself, are you?"
"It seems like you haven't been medicated at all, so maybe your depression is a lie?"
"There are people like that, huh? People who want attention, so they pretend to be sick."
"If you've never overdosed or cut yourself, it's weird to say you're mentally ill."
"Don't you think it's disrespectful to people who are really suffering from illness?"

--actually the type of Menhera who would mount me like a crazy person!?

[Translated From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23844]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主人公奏太每月去看一次心理治疗师。
某天，他在医院偶然遇见同学航，两人由此成为朋友。

然而，航却……

“有心理问题的人，不都会割腕吗？”
“都不割腕，算什么真正的抑郁症啊？”
“看起来你根本没怎么吃药，所谓的抑郁症该不会是骗人的吧？”
“是有这种人呢，为了得到关注，就假装自己有病。”
“从没药物过量，也没割过腕，却说自己有心理问题，很奇怪吧。”
“你不觉得这样很不尊重那些真正因疾病而痛苦的人吗？”

——竟然是个会疯狂地压人一头、争当病情更重者的麻烦家伙！？
